todos.title: Get UK passports for both children
todos.notes: Both children born in Germany to German mother. Already have German passports. British citizens by descent (Nick is British by birth, married to mother at time of birth — straightforward claim). Applying for UK passports from Germany. Nick's UK passport and UK birth certificate are available. Countersignatory identified. IMPORTANT: Nick has internationale Geburtsurkunden (multilingual birth certificates) for both children. HMPO does NOT accept Multilingual Standard Forms (MSFs) since Brexit. You still need the standard German Geburtsurkunde + certified English translation. The internationale version alone will NOT be accepted.

todos.notes: Address: Schießgartenstraße 3, Götzenhain (Stadtteil of Dreieich). CORRECTED: Stadt Dreieich handles Einbürgerung directly (43,600+ residents, above 7,500 threshold). NOT Kreis Offenbach. Application goes to Stadt Dreieich → forwarded to Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt for decision. Contact: Stadt Dreieich, Hauptstraße 45, 63303 Dreieich. Email: stadt@dreieich.de. Tel: 06103 601-0. Married to German citizen. 10+ years residency (far exceeds 3-year minimum for spouses). B1 certificate and naturalization test already completed. Fee: €255 adult (collected by RP Darmstadt). Timeline: 18-24 months processing.

todos.title: Check Ford Kuga PHEV charging cable compatibility with German public stations
todos.notes: Ford Kuga 2021 full hybrid / PHEV. Check whether the included charging cable (likely Type 2 / Mennekes) works at standard German public charging points. Kuga PHEV onboard charger maxes at 3.7kW. Type 2 is the EU standard so it SHOULD be compatible, but verify the specific cable that came with the car (Mode 2 domestic vs Mode 3 public). If it's only a Mode 2 granny cable, you may need a separate Type 2-to-Type 2 Mode 3 cable for public stations (~€150-300).
